newsitem.title: USA: US Treasury announces references for indexed notes.
newsitem.headline: US Treasury announces references for indexed notes.

text.p: The Treasury announced on Tuesday the reference Consumer Price Index numbers and the daily index ratios for January 1997 for its new 10-year inflation-indexed notes.

It said on Monday that it anticipated the official offering announcement would be released on January 21, with the auction to be held on January 29. The inflation-indexed notes would be issued on February 6, dated January 15.
The Treasury noted that the index for the CPI (Unadjusted) for September 1996 was 157.8, for October 1996 was 158.3 and for November 1996 was 158.6
It put the reference CPI and index ratio for January 15, 1997, at 158.43548 and 1.00000 and for January 31 at 158.59032 and 1.00098.
The Treasury said the auction date for the series A-2007 notes would be January 29, the original issue dated date January 15 and the original issue date February 6.
It said the maturity date would be January 15, 2007.
